NONE: › needing urgent attention, or demanding too much from other people

C: › [ C ] a person who is sent or kept away from their own country, etc.

NONE: › to send someone away from their own country, village, etc., especially for political reasons
（尤指出於政治原因的）流放，放逐，流亡

example: The king went into exile because of the political situation in his country.

遭到罷免的那些領導人現在流亡鄰國。

由於發生了政變，國王被迫流亡。

I: B1 to be, or to be real
C1 to live, or to live in difficult conditions

example: I don't think ghosts exist.
我認為鬼是不存在的。
Poverty still exists in this country.
這個國家仍存在貧困現象。

一些物種僅存於這一小片森林中，地球上其他地方都沒有。

很少有人能在斷水的情況下生存超過一星期。

無法想像有甚麼人能靠這麼低的工資維持生計。

U: B2 [ U ] the fact of something or someone existing
C usually singular: C1 [ C usually singular ] a particular way of life

現代宇宙論認為，宇宙大約在150億年前就已經形成了。

有人認為這座雕像是唯一現存的聖佛雷德斯維德的塑像。

NONE: › a system of ideas made famous by Jean Paul Sartre in the 1940s in which the world has no meaning and each person is alone and completely responsible for their own actions, by which they make their own character
存在主義（尚•保羅•沙特在20世紀40年代創建的理論）
B2 used to refer to something that exists now

A2 a smaller road used to leave a main road

I or T: › to leave a building or large vehicle
離開（建築物或大型交通工具）
